## Type

- [ ] feat
- [ ] fix
- [ ] refactor
- [ ] test
- [ ] docs / ci / chore

## Target branch

- [ ] `feature/*` → `develop` (or into a parent feature branch for a stacked PR)
- [ ] `release/*` or `hotfix/*` → `main`

## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug` passes locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests
- [ ] ADR added in `docs/adr/` if this changes architecture or process
